notes.title: v1.0 - Full Release
notes.content:
Huge thanks to all the play testers that got us here.

This is the first official release version of the Cat Café, which wouldn't have been possible without all the amazing feedback and suggestions that you submitted to us over the last month.

Thank you so much!

notes.title: v0.9.1 - Now compatible with VTubeStudio, VNyan & Warudo!
notes.content:
We heard that test players felt limited by having to use VSeeFace, so the Cat Café has now been upgraded and tested for VTubeStudio, VNyan and Warudo!

It should also work for any app that allows for Spout2 capture, but the above is what we've confirmed it works with.

A reminder that even if you can't get your vtuber integrated, the Cat Café still works as a Twitch Integrated Background for your stream, which you can layer your vtuber on top of in OBS.

notes.title: v0.9 - Now compatible with VTubeStudio!
notes.content:
Users said they want to use VTubeStudio, not VSeeFace, so Stream Environments: Cat Café is now compatible with VTubeStudio as well!

If you use something other than VTubeStudio or VSeeface, you can still use Cat Café as a Twitch Integrated background. The only benefits of plugging your vtuber in via VTS/VSF is being more integrated into the scene with some redeems appearing in front of you.
